sloka: स विस्फार्य महच्चापं किरीटी मृष्टकुण्डलः।नाम विश्रावयामास ननाद च महास्वनम् ।। ६.७१.५ ।।
transliteration: sa visphārya mahaccāpaṁ kirīṭī mṛṣṭakuṇḍalaḥ।nāma viśrāvayāmāsa nanāda ca mahāsvanam ।। 6.71.5 ।।

translations.english: Adorned with crown, and polished earrings, twanging his bow, proclaimed his name and roared sounding aloud.
